- Look in the class repository on GitHub and in the desktop. I will make a new folder in module 2 called “In_class_exercise”

- the R code, make a summary of bruv.csv, and plot of bruv.csv. Commit and push your new code.

#### 2. Make your own repository

- Use the tutorial called Exercise Github Setup to make your own private repository

- invite the professor.
